turns.assessment: The four-week rise in transmit laser bias current is the documented signature of incipient laser ageing in trx.och181.a. Stable optical power, OSNR, pre-FEC BER, DGD, and SOP measurements argue against a path, amplifier, receiver, or service fault. There is no immediate service impact, but the trend can precede transmitter failure, so a planned proactive replacement of the line interface is warranted rather than emergency intervention.
